definitions.explanation: A state or condition without oxygen. Used in scientific contexts for processes that occur without oxygen, and in mountaineering for climbing without supplemental oxygen tanks.

examples.japanese: エベレストを{無酸素|むさんそ}で{登頂|とうちょう}した。
examples.english: He summited Everest without supplemental oxygen.

examples.japanese: {無酸素|むさんそ}{運動|うんどう}は{短時間|たんじかん}で{筋力|きんりょく}を{鍛|きた}えるのに{効果的|こうかてき}だ。
examples.english: Anaerobic exercise is effective for building muscle strength in a short time.

examples.japanese: {無酸素|むさんそ}{状態|じょうたい}では、{特定|とくてい}の{細菌|さいきん}だけが{生存|せいぞん}できる。
examples.english: In an oxygen-free environment, only certain bacteria can survive.

notes:
USAGE:
The prefix {無|む}～ means "without" and attaches to many Sino-Japanese nouns. Used in two main contexts: (1) mountaineering — climbing without supplemental oxygen ({無酸素|むさんそ}{登頂|とうちょう}), and (2) science — anaerobic conditions or exercise.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無酸素|むさんそ}{登頂|とうちょう} (oxygen-free summit, climbing without supplemental O₂)
- {無酸素|むさんそ}{運動|うんどう} (anaerobic exercise)
- {無酸素|むさんそ}{状態|じょうたい} (oxygen-free state)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {有酸素|ゆうさんそ}: aerobic — the opposite
- {有酸素運動|ゆうさんそうんどう}: aerobic exercise
